ModMetadata.Name: Inventory Peek
ModMetadata.Author: XCeled
ModMetadata.Description:
Keep every inventory window open without it covering the screen.
Click the eye on an inventory window's title bar to make that kind of window hidable. A hidable window disappears while you play and comes back the moment you hold Alt (the mouse-control key) to use the cursor, exactly where you left it. Click the eye again to keep it always visible.
The choice is remembered per kind of item (your hardsuit, your backpack, your mining belt), across sessions and when you swap to another item of the same kind.
Nothing about the windows themselves changes: they stay open, docked or undocked, as the game has them. Client side only; safe in multiplayer.
You need to install StationeersLaunchPad for this mod to work: https://github.com/StationeersLaunchPad/StationeersLaunchPad
